verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents its own bulk capabilities: imports that add or update records across multiple objects and their associations, and batch retrieval of custom object records through the API. Beyond those two paths, bulk operations are thin in the evidence, and nothing shows an AI-native route (such as the MCP server) acting on many items at once. Missing for 10: documented batch create/update/delete API endpoints, bulk edit or delete of records, bulk operations via the MCP server or agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You can retrieve custom object records individually or in batches.
